image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a pale cream to light beige coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing on a forest floor. The fungus features a complex, multi-branched structure arising from a central base, with numerous upright branches dividing into finer, club-shaped tips. The background consists of blurred brown leaf litter, twigs, and sparse green grass blades.
